headline: Nalco moves forward with Rs 30,000 crore smelter project
hook: Nalco accelerates massive aluminium capacity expansion
summary: National Aluminium Company (Nalco) is advancing its Rs 30,000 crore brownfield expansion project for its aluminium smelter. The project aims to significantly increase the company's production capacity. This capital expenditure is part of Nalco's long-term growth strategy to strengthen its position in the domestic and global aluminium markets. Retail investors should note the impact of this large-scale investment on the company's future earnings potential and debt profile.
why_it_matters: Long-term production growth could boost Nalco's future profitability.
winners_losers: Nalco gains / Competitors face long-term supply pressure

headline: NALCO forecasts higher aluminium prices for Q4 due to low inventory
hook: Aluminium price outlook rises for Q4
summary: National Aluminium Company (NALCO) expects average aluminium prices to range between $2,950 and $3,150 per tonne in the fourth quarter. The company attributes this price projection to tight global stock levels. This outlook suggests a favorable pricing environment for domestic aluminium producers. Indian retail investors should note that higher metal prices typically boost the margins of primary aluminium manufacturers.
why_it_matters: Higher aluminium prices may improve NALCO's quarterly profit margins.
winners_losers: Aluminium producers gain / downstream manufacturers hurt

summary: National Aluminium Company (NALCO) reported a 28% increase in net profit for the second quarter of fiscal 2026-27, driven by strong operational performance. Indian retail investors tracking metal stocks will note the strong earnings as a sign of resilient domestic demand and commodity pricing power.
why_it_matters: Strong NALCO earnings boost sentiment for state-owned metal stocks.

headline: National Aluminium Company reports a 28% rise in net profit for the second quarter and announces a dividend
hook: Strong aluminum demand lifts quarterly profits
summary: National Aluminium Company (NALCO) reported a net profit of ₹1,835 crore for the second quarter of the financial year, marking a 28% increase compared to the same period last year. Alongside the financial results, the company declared an interim dividend of ₹4.5 per share for its shareholders. The earnings reflect solid operational performance in the metal sector. For Indian retail investors, the higher payout and profit growth highlight steady cash flows in state-backed metal producers.
